title: Inline SVG icon module
summary: ICONS table of 239 inline currentColor SVG strings (24px viewBox) plus icon(name, size) returning a span wrapper and hasIcon(name). No icon library. Includes agent, agentChat and terminal from formlit; the three-star sparkle icon is banned.
description: Call `icon(name, size)` inside an `el()` template. Unknown names fall back to `info`. Add a new icon as a new entry in the table; never import an icon package. `agent`, `agentChat` and `terminal` are the icons for Claude Code surfaces. Two icons (`paintbrush`, `hand`) come from Remix Icon (Apache-2.0) per NOTICE.md.
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.doc: Map of icon name to inline SVG string (viewBox 24, stroke currentColor).

exports.signature: export function icon(name: string, size = 16): string
exports.doc: Returns a span.icon wrapper of the given pixel size around the named SVG; an unknown name shows info.
True when the name is a key of ICONS.

renameables: icon entries that name formvis-only tools

invariants.text: Icons are inline currentColor SVG strings from the icons module (icon(name, size)); no icon library, and the three-star sparkle icon is banned under any name.
The icon wrapper is aria-hidden; controls that carry an icon also carry an aria-label.

thirdParty.name: NodeMode stylized design system: tokens, theme profiles, theme boot, dom-stable helpers, icon subset
